blocks.x: Omnichannel retail wins on promise-keeping: availability, delivery promise, price consistency and service resolution across channels. The decision infrastructure behind those promises — demand sensing, allocation, pricing — decides margin before marketing spends a cent.

The workflows we industrialize here: Demand sensing and pricing, Allocation/replenishment, Order promise and fulfillment, Shelf operations, Loyalty and personalization. Each arrives with its current cycle times measured in the Diagnose phase, and each leaves the program governed by outcome SLOs rather than anecdotes.

items: Forecasts update weekly while baskets shift daily; markdowns and stockouts both inherit the lag.
Store/DC allocation on legacy rules; phantom availability coexists with overstock.
OOS and planogram drift discovered at audit; camera estates idle.
Consent and profiling governance is not yet defined; personalization ships as generic segments.
Trading peaks break cost and reliability models; P95 cost per order unknown.
Account takeover drains points and trust; controls static.

blocks.x: How we help — five priority capabilities

items: streaming signals into daily SKU-store forecasts — forecast error down 20-35%
size-curve and DC logic proposed to planners — OOS and overstock both down
OOS/planogram detection on existing cameras — shelf fixed in minutes
consent-scoped profiling with clean-room measurement — lift verified
load/chaos readiness for trading peaks — peaks absorbed
